stem:
An ideal operational amplifier (op-amp) is to be used in a comparator circuit. Part of the comparator circuit is shown in Fig. 7.1.

{{figure:figure_7_1.png}}

Three resistors, each of resistance $1000\Omega$, and a negative temperature coefficient thermistor are available to complete the circuit.

The circuit is to be designed so that, at low temperatures, the output $V_{OUT}$ is $-5.0\text{ V}$ and at higher temperatures, the output $V_{OUT}$ is to be $+5.0\text{ V}$.
